resources.string: Invalid Last.fm API key or shared secret
The Last.fm authorization expired. Connect again.
ListenBrainz refused the token. Connect again.
Off by default. Enter your user token from listenbrainz.org/settings to send the music you play in Wicaby to ListenBrainz.
Off by default. Last.fm needs your own API account: open Advanced to enter its key and secret.
Create an API account at last.fm/api/account/create (any name, no callback URL), then enter its API key and shared secret here.
Open the Last.fm page (or scan the QR code), sign in, and choose Yes, allow access. Wicaby is waiting.
Tracks you play in Wicaby are scrobbled once you’ve heard half of them or 4 minutes.
If your server already scrobbles (a Last.fm or ListenBrainz plugin, or Navidrome), leave this off to avoid duplicates.
Tokens and secrets are encrypted by the Android Keystore on this device and are never logged.
